name: Sz 51

paper.title: Planet-forming disks and their environment across regions and time from the full NIR census

notes: SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (DESTINYS survey). Tenuous signal detected around the coronagraph extending to North and South, too tenuous to characterize the disk geometry (Garufi et al. 2026). Note: this Schwartz-catalog 'Sz 51' is the Chamaeleon PMS star V* BC Cha, not a Lupus source.
